note: `properties_varint_guard.validated_varint_len` is the semantic view of whether the vulnerable `decode_variable_length((char *) p, &len_len)` call would complete within the caller's remaining MQTT suffix `end - p`: the instrumentation emits the byte count that a length-aware decode would consume, or 0 when the suffix is truncated. `properties_varint_read.remaining_bytes` carries the vulnerable caller expression `end - p` into `decode_variable_length()` so the sink-side `offset` can be compared against the exact suffix extent. `properties_varint_read.decode_base_ptr` and `properties_varint_read.read_offset` are the callee-side base pointer and index used by the vulnerable sink dereference `p[offset]`.
